_note: This year's lineup for /candles/, in the order of the scent markers at the sale. Each scent is site.pricePerCandle; xl: true adds the XL size at xlDonation. art is the label drawing in src/images/scents/. secretScents: true shows an "under wraps" card for the new scents held back until the sale; set it false once they are revealed (and add them to scents).

scents.name: Just Crackle
scents.description: For when you’re wick-ed tired of scents and just want to burn it straight.

scents.name: Charcoal Rose
scents.description: Where beauty burns slow — petals kissed by smoke, grounded in sandalwood and secrets. A scent that smolders rather than blooms.

scents.name: Apple Of My Eye
scents.description: An orchard stroll in candle form, with cinnamon as your tour guide and vanilla as the afterparty.

scents.name: True North
scents.description: A scent that makes even Santa consider relocating his workshop to the Alps.

scents.name: Oh My Darling
scents.description: It’s like a fruit salad went on vacation and came back with a tan and a tropical accent.

scents.name: T4G Labs
scents.description: A playground for our wilder ideas — unexpected blends, bold mistakes, and happy accidents, all poured just for fun.

scents.name: Winter Wonderland
scents.description: It’s like hugging a pine tree without the sap — pure holiday forest air, no axe required.

scents.name: Rekindled
scents.description: Because good things deserve a second spark — and you’re too classy to toss glass.

scents.name: Pumpkin Pie
scents.description: It’s Thanksgiving at your in-laws, but without the awkward questions — just the sweet and spicy aroma of pumpkin pie.

scents.name: Tea Time
scents.description: Spice up your life (and your living room) with a scent that’s less holiday tea party, more seasonal soirée.

scents.name: Old Fashioned
scents.description: Smells like your favorite speakeasy decided to moonlight as a candlemaker — sweet, rich, and socially refined.

extras.name: Candle Lid
extras.description: Enhance your candles with beautiful thick wood candle lids. Helps preserve fragrance for longer.
